summary:
Strategic architectural review and revised implementation plan proposing the Optimum Customer Flow for Portabox quoting and booking:
1. Architectural Critique of Current vs. Optimum Funnel: Highlights the friction of the current 8-step journey before price reveal and presents the high-converting 2-stage model (Fast 3-Step Instant Quote < 45s + Dedicated 3-Step Booking Confirmation).
2. Stage 1 (Fast Instant Quote): Where & What (Postcode + Storage at home/location or Move) -> Container Size & Volume -> Instant Transparent Quote with 30-day lock & 1-field contact capture.
3. Stage 2 (Seamless Booking Wizard): Delivery Date & Window (Calendar) -> Driveway Clearance & Site Notes -> Account PIN & Card Payment.
4. Complete synthesis of the CEO Smartsheet improvements (terminology cleanup, Queensland hub consolidation to Brisbane, Zone E base + $5/km, and simplified duration discounts).
